provenance: Declarative finite construction, with analytic proof in the companion note; no graph generator or checker executed.
vertex_set: Disjoint vertices P_i and L_i for indices i=1,...,13 in the displayed representative order.
adjacency: P_i--L_j exactly when the sum of the three coordinate products is 0 modulo 3; no other edges.
no_matching_cut_argument: Every nonempty induced shore would have minimum degree at least 3, be bipartite and have no four-cycle. Pair counting requires at least 14 vertices in each shore, hence at least 28 overall, contradicting 26.

finite_parameter_scope.limitation: This graph is not admissible for d=4 or g>=7 and is not an unbounded-girth counterexample family.
